claims.text: TOOLS registers memory_route and memory_bootcheck as read-effect ToolSpecs with closed input schemas, where memory_bootcheck requires an observed object with agent_version, memory_gen, head and entry_sha256.
_route and _bootcheck delegate to the domain route and bootcheck functions with the declared arguments, and carry the _memory_contract and _memory_resume marker attributes.

Import time calls store._install_resume_dispatch, _install_memory_publication, _install_resume_json and _install_resume_lifecycle, while VALIDATORS and FOLDS stay empty so no state or event is owned here.

decision.rule: Change here when the memory resume tool schemas, delegation, or dispatch installation needs to change.
decision.failure: A resume tool is missing from the registry, an observed bootcheck payload is rejected, or dispatch wiring is absent after import.
